faq.q: How is a titanium dental abutment (angled) manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium dental abutment (angled) is manufactured using VAR melting; Closed-die hot forging; CNC swiss turning; Thread rolling. BOZE CNC Ti uses precision CNC equipment with strict process controls to ensure consistent quality and dimensional accuracy.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Ti-6Al-4V ELI (ASTM F136) for titanium dental abutment (angled)?
faq.a: Alternative materials include stainless steel (heavier, susceptible to corrosion) and aluminum (lower strength, shorter fatigue life). The alternative manufacturing method is Machining from solid billet (90%+ material waste, no grain flow optimization).

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium dental abutment (angled)?
faq.a: Titanium Dental Abutment (Angled) components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply.

faq.q: What are common failure modes for titanium dental abutment (angled)?
faq.a: Common failure modes include Surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (ASTM F86). BOZE CNC Ti mitigates these through strict process control, proper material selection, and 100% inspection.
